integrity.claim_scope: Complete quotient CW homotopy type and induced integral deck-group homology lattice.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit finite orbit CW presentation, homotopy-preserving two-complex generator eliminations, and universal-cover chain complex.
integrity.verification: Dependency-free exact reproduction of simplex orbits and all nine free-group eliminations.

limitations: Only the 3-by-5 ordinary chessboard complex and cyclic rotation of its five columns are classified.
The homotopy classification does not claim an equivariant geometric cell-by-cell identification or a homeomorphism.
Unindexed equivalent theorems and general transformation-group results remain possible.
title: A Moore-space splitting and integral deck lattice for the fivefold chessboard quotient
